description: This PHP script manages banner access control list (ACL) settings within the Revive Adserver admin interface. It handles permission enforcement, session management, ACL adjustments, caching, and rendering of the ACL configuration page for banners.

classes.name: OA_Permission
classes.description: Class handling permission enforcement and access control.

classes.name: OA
classes.description: Class providing utility functions like getNow.

classes.name: MAX_AclAdjust
classes.description: Function adjusting ACLs based on actions.

classes.name: OA_Admin_UI
classes.description: Class for managing admin UI messages.

classes.name: Admin_DA
classes.description: Data Access class for retrieving campaign and banner data.
